RED_TEXT_SUBTITLE: Show the text of deleted messages in red.
DELETED_MARKER_SUBTITLE: Show “This message was deleted” under deleted messages, with a Dismiss link.
INLINE_EDITS_SUBTITLE: Show earlier versions of an edited message above its current text.
LOG_DELETES_SUBTITLE: Keep deleted messages in the chat.
LOG_EDITS_SUBTITLE: Keep the earlier versions of edited messages.
LOG_DELETED_ATTACHMENTS_SUBTITLE: Keep attachments removed by an edit, marked as deleted.
IGNORE_BOTS_SUBTITLE: Do not log messages sent by bots.
IGNORE_SELF_SUBTITLE: Do not log your own messages.
IGNORE_USERS_SUBTITLE: User IDs whose messages are not logged. Separate IDs with commas or spaces.
IGNORE_CHANNELS_SUBTITLE: Channel or category IDs that are not logged. Separate IDs with commas or spaces.
IGNORE_GUILDS_SUBTITLE: Server IDs that are not logged. Separate IDs with commas or spaces.
LOG_CLEARED: Cleared the log of {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}.
PERSIST_CAPTURE_DETAIL: Starts off. Saves only messages this client observes being edited or deleted.
CAPTURE_CHANNELS_DETAIL: Comma or space separated. Blank allows all accessible channels; other ignore filters still apply.
CLEAR_SAVED_ACCOUNT: Clear saved history for this account
CLEAR_ACCOUNT_CONFIRM: Permanently clear this account’s locally saved history?
CLEAR_ALL_SAVED: Clear saved history for ALL accounts
CLEAR_ALL_CONFIRM: Permanently clear all locally saved history on this device?
ARCHIVE_PRIVACY_DETAIL: Use only where participants permit. No uncaptured-message recovery. File names only; no attachment downloads. Device backups may contain history. Wait for Saved locally in the archive before force-closing. Age/count limits cover all accounts combined; older records expire when the app runs.
RESTORE_IN_CHANNEL: Restore saved deletions in their original channel
RESTORE_IN_CHANNEL_DETAIL: Shows retained captured deletions as local red messages when Discord loads that part of the channel. Does not send messages or restore uncaptured content.
DELETED_COLOR_DETAIL: Choose the color used for captured deleted messages. Red text must be enabled.
